listingTitle: Avoid repeated Java List membership scans
title: Avoid repeated Java List membership scans
why: List.contains scans linearly, so calling it inside another loop can turn a linear pass into quadratic work.
suggestion: Build a HashSet before the loop when repeated membership checks dominate and list ordering is not part of lookup semantics.
limitations: Only variables whose nearest declaration before the loop is List, ArrayList, LinkedList, or Vector and that use contains inside a braced loop are reported.
Nested generic declarations, collection size, aliases, and intentionally small lists are not inferred.
